codeReview.summary: Reviewed the feature against its description and expectedBehavior. The commit delivers the requested frontend scaffold: Tailwind CSS v4 integration, React Router v7 routes (/login, /dashboard, /transactions, /categories, root redirect), AuthContext auto-auth check via GET /api/users/me, ProtectedRoute, responsive Layout navigation with user display area, reusable UI components, placeholder pages with empty states, DTO types, Vitest/RTL setup, and Vite proxy for /api (and /ws). One non-blocking requirement mismatch was found in API client base URL configuration.

issues.description: Feature spec and AGENTS frontend convention call for API client base URL http://localhost:8080, but implementation uses relative '/api'. This works in dev via Vite proxy, but it is a documented requirement mismatch.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared conventions are inconsistent for API base URL usage: AGENTS mandates an absolute backend URL while the scaffold intentionally uses a proxy-friendly relative '/api' base. This mismatch can create avoidable review noise.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md frontend convention states 'API client in src/api/client.ts with base URL http://localhost:8080'; implementation uses BASE_URL = '/api' in frontend/src/api/client.ts:3 and Vite proxy in frontend/vite.config.ts.

sharedStateObservations.observation: frontend-worker skill still prescribes strict TDD red-phase for scaffold work; this does not fit initial bootstrap features well and was explicitly called out by the worker.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill step 3 requires writing failing tests first and confirming failure (.factory/skills/frontend-worker/SKILL.md lines 24-27). Handoff skillFeedback.suggestedChanges requests adjusting this expectation for foundation scaffolds (handoff file: 2026-03-23T09-43-26-773Z__foundation-frontend-scaffold__c44f51f8-8031-48b5-ac5e-2fd14951431c.json).

summary: Feature passes review: scaffold implementation is complete and aligned with expected behavior, with one non-blocking spec mismatch around API client base URL. Added shared-state observations for conventions alignment and frontend-worker skill guidance.
